## What happens

Tell us what you typed and what you got instead.

## What you expected

Tell us what the right answer would have been.

## Where it happened

- The Android keyboard
- The web demo
- The application page

## Details

- The version of the app, from the about section
- The version of Android
- The theme, light or dark
- Whether the word list and the completion were on

## The word itself

If you can, tell us the word in Manglish. A wrong answer on a real word is
worth much more to us than a crash.
